doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Clayton-Hamilton band compared with the Basie band
summary: Young says his current Clayton-Hamilton band has the same spark as the 1957 Basie band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Clayton-Hamilton‘s band. That‘s quite a band. Have you heard that band?
What do you think of that band?
I‘m glad I asked you that…
Oh, yeah. Young:…because that band is…and I played in them other bands. I think this Clayton- Hamilton band is good as that band we just through talking to.
That‘s saying something if you‘re saying that any band is as good as this Basie band.
That‘s what I‘m talking about. This band, when it fires up, you feel the same spark in this band that happened in that band. That‘s true.
